chapters.title: Front matter and Prologue — The Conditions and Practice of This Science
chapters.short: Front matter and the prologue on the conditions of the science
chapters.summary: The editions, sources and title, the reference charts, and the prologue: the conditions of the science — licence (idhn), purity, diet and discipline, timing, facing the qibla, and the rest — which the book places before every operation.

chapters.title: On the letters of the alphabet (ḥurūf al- muʿjam) and the secrets and concealments (iḍmārāt) they contain
chapters.short: The letters, their elements and natures
chapters.summary: The twenty-eight letters: their elements and natures, the luminous and the dark, and the friendship and enmity of the elements toward one another.

chapters.title: On breaking and spreading (al-kasr wa- l-basṭ) and the ordering of the operations according to the [proper] times and hours
chapters.short: Breaking and spreading (kasr wa-basṭ); hours, planets, the nine mīzān
chapters.summary: Breaking and spreading the letters, and fitting every operation to its time: the auspicious and inauspicious hours, the angels of the letters, the properties, days, incense and letters of the planets, the terrestrial spirits, the tables of the days, the method of basṭ, the degrees of the elements, the nine mīzān, the numerical basṭ and the multiplication of letters.

chapters.title: On the astrological judgements (aḥkām) governing the twenty-eight lunar mansions of the celestial sphere [24]
chapters.short: The twenty-eight lunar mansions
chapters.summary: The judgements of the twenty-eight lunar mansions: their distribution among the signs, their risings, their division among the seasons, the Arabs' rhymed sayings on them, and how to know which sign the moon is in.

chapters.title: On an account of the twelve zodiacal signs and the indications and bindings that belong to them
chapters.short: The twelve signs and the planets
chapters.summary: The twelve signs and their indications: lands, divisions of time, winds, the heavens, the moon and stars, the planets' bodies, sojourns, exaltations and natures, the Milky Way, hostile signs, and the letters and months of the signs.

chapters.title: On the secrets of ﴾In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate﴿ and the hidden secrets and blessings that belong to it [51]
chapters.short: The secrets of the Basmala
chapters.summary: The secrets and blessings of the Basmala, its letters and numbers, and the workings built on it.

chapters.title: On spiritual retreat (khalwa) and what pertains specially to the practitioners of the devotional seclusions (iʿtikāf) that give access to the celestial realms [75]
chapters.short: Spiritual retreat (khalwa) and seclusion
chapters.summary: Spiritual retreat and the devotional seclusions that open onto the higher realms.

chapters.title: On the names by which our master Jesus — peace be upon him — used to bring the dead to life, by the leave of God, glorified and exalted [83]
chapters.short: The names by which ʿĪsā raised the dead
chapters.summary: The names by which ʿĪsā, peace be upon him, raised the dead, and their workings.

chapters.title: On the four seasonal quarters (thawāqīf) and the revolving seasons that pertain specially to them
chapters.short: The four seasonal quarters
chapters.summary: The four seasonal quarters and the seasons that belong to them.

chapters.title: On the occult properties of the openings of the firmly established (muḥkamāt) suras of the Qurʾān and of the clear verses
chapters.short: The openings of the suras (fawātiḥ)
chapters.summary: The occult properties of the openings of the firmly established suras and of the clear verses.

chapters.title: On the secrets of the Fātiḥa and its renowned occult properties and invocations [110]
chapters.short: The secrets of the Fātiḥa
chapters.summary: The secrets of the Fātiḥa, its renowned properties and its invocations.

chapters.title: On the originations of the divine Mercy (al-ikhtirāʿāt al- raḥamūtiyya) and the radiant, shining lights, within the lights of Mercy [114]
chapters.short: The originations of the divine Mercy
chapters.summary: The originations of the divine Mercy and the lights within it.

chapters.title: On the Greatest Name of God and the hidden operative deployments (taṣārīf) that belong to it[120]
chapters.short: The Greatest Name and its deployments
chapters.summary: The Greatest Name of God and its hidden operative deployments.

chapters.title: On the letters absent from the noble Fātiḥa (sawāqiṭal-Fātiḥa) and the awfāq and invocations that belong to them [132]
chapters.short: The letters absent from the Fātiḥa (sawāqiṭ)
chapters.summary: The seven letters absent from the Fātiḥa, and the awfāq and invocations that belong to them.

chapters.title: On the litanies of remembrance (adhkār) and the answered invocations that compel obedience [150]
chapters.short: Litanies, invocations and the qasam corpus
chapters.summary: The litanies of remembrance and the answered invocations; the long corpus of qasam and the names that serve them.

chapters.title: On the conditions binding upon some and not others, from the commencement of beginnings to the suns of endings [165]
chapters.short: The conditions binding on the practitioner
chapters.summary: The conditions binding upon some practitioners and not others, from the first beginnings to the final stations.

chapters.title: On the Most Beautiful Names of God and on their beneficial, tried-and- tested awfāq [190]
chapters.short: The Most Beautiful Names
chapters.summary: The Most Beautiful Names of God, one faṣl to each, with their values, squares and tried benefits.

chapters.title: On the occult properties of Kāf-Hāʾ- Yāʾ-ʿAyn-Ṣād and of its lordly, most holy letters [260]
chapters.short: Kāf-Hā-Yā-ʿAyn-Ṣād and its seal
chapters.summary: The properties of Kāf-Hā-Yā-ʿAyn-Ṣād and of its lordly seal.

chapters.title: On the occult properties of the Throne Verse (Q 2:255) and the God-given (ladunnī) blessings that belong to it [284]
chapters.short: Āyat al-Kursī
chapters.summary: The properties of the Throne Verse and the God-given secrets in it.

chapters.title: On the occult properties of certain tried-and-tested awfāq and talismans [291]
chapters.short: The awfāq and talismans
chapters.summary: The tried-and-tested awfāq and talismans: the stations and spirits of every square, the rules of construction for the threefold to the tenfold, the letter squares, and their workings.

chapters.title: On the noble Sūrat Yā-Sīn and the answered invocations that belong to it [303]
chapters.short: Sūrat Yā-Sīn and the daily awrād
chapters.summary: Sūrat Yā-Sīn and its answered invocations, and the daily litanies from Sunday to Saturday.

chapters.title: Applied workings, the verses of healing, ciphers, and the index of the divine names
chapters.short: Applied workings, healing verses, ciphers, index
chapters.summary: Applied workings drawn from the sūras, the verses of healing, the treatments for epilepsy and jinn-affliction, the ciphers, the index of the divine names, and Ṣalāt al-Fātiḥ.
